name: nansen
_source: Project Gutenberg #30197 (Vol I) and #34120 (Vol II) — Fridtjof Nansen's 'Farthest North'

entries.title: The Fram Enters the Ice
entries._note: Anchored on the Wednesday September 20 1893 entry — the moment Nansen realized the Fram was being beset for good. The Sept 25 'Frozen in faster and faster' entry is famously brief (a single 215-char paragraph followed by a chapter break), so it can't carry the entry on its own. Date shifted from Sept 25 to Sept 20 to align with body.

entries.title: Farthest North
entries._note: Anchored on 'Friday, April 5th' — start of the multi-day push and turnaround narrative culminating in the 86°13.6′ N record on April 8. Date shifted from 04-07 to 04-05 to match the body's opening date.

entries.title: Wintering in Franz Josef Land
entries._note: Anchored on 'September 7th, set to work to build our hut'. The archive originally placed this on August 26 but the actual hut construction began September 7 1895 — date updated to match.
